package suite // import "github.com/airencracken/comfylib/suite"

func CheckDiscussion(token, sourcePath, binding, thread, forum string) bool

func ConfiguredDiscussionReturn(raw, apps string) (string, error)

func DiscussionResult(destination, thread string) string

func DiscussionReturn(raw, source, apps string) (string, error)

func FinishDiscussion(token string)

func PrepareDiscussion(handoff, source, binding string) (string, error)

func RenderDiscussion(w http.ResponseWriter, action, source, thread, state, csrfKey, csrf, css string)

func TemplateFuncs(prefix string) (template.FuncMap, error)

type App struct {
	ID  string `json:"id"`
	URL string `json:"url"`
}

func ParseApps(raw string) ([]App, error)

func (a App) Name() string

type Auth struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}

func NewAuth(c AuthConfig, p Provider, db *sql.DB, h AuthHooks) (*Auth, error)

func (a *Auth) Register(mux *http.ServeMux)

type AuthConfig struct{ App, Issuer, ClientID, ClientSecret, BaseURL string }

type AuthHooks struct {
	RateKey func(*http.Request) string
	Current func(*http.Request) (int64, string)
	CSRF    func(*http.Request) (string, string)
	SignIn  func(http.ResponseWriter, *http.Request, int64) (string, error)
}

type Identity struct{ Issuer, Subject string }

type Provider interface {
	Authorize(context.Context, string, string, string) (string, error)
	Exchange(context.Context, string, string, string) (Identity, error)
}
